name: Live Weave is a separate ephemeral presentation
steps: Open the playground and confirm Frozen Weave is the default
Switch to Live Weave
Inspect the LIVE / EPHEMERAL badge and moving visual field
Switch back to Frozen Weave
expected: Frozen Weave remains unchanged and replayable; Live Weave is clearly marked ephemeral and does not overwrite the frozen session.

name: Pointer motion bends Flow Field without restart
steps: Switch to Live Weave
Keep Browser Local enabled
Move the pointer quickly across the visual field
Stop moving and watch the field settle
expected: The Flow Field changes continuously with pointer motion and transitions smoothly rather than restarting or jumping to a new page state.

name: Weights alter live influence and motion
steps: Load demo signals in Live Weave
Move the Working Chat weight toward 100
Move Simulation State toward 0
Inspect the live influence percentages and visual field
expected: The percentages renormalize and the animated field visibly changes while the underlying Frozen Weave source controls receive the same weights.

name: Working Chat packet updates while renderer stays live
steps: Switch to Live Weave
Open Inject / replace a live packet
Choose Working Chat
Inject a valid JSON packet with provenance
Inject a different valid packet
expected: Working Chat remains one weighted source among others; each valid packet changes the live field without restarting the renderer.

name: Empty enabled organs wait in Live Weave
steps: Enable a JSON source organ with an empty packet
Switch to Live Weave
Inspect its source row
expected: The source is shown as waiting with zero normalized influence and does not break the moving field.

name: Internet Eye remains target blind in Live Weave
steps: Supply a Shodan-compatible observation packet containing IP, hostname, org and banner fields
Enable Internet Eye with provenance
Switch to Live Weave and inspect the live panel
expected: The visual field uses only a reduced aggregate. Raw target identifiers are never rendered into the live influence panel or saved by Live Weave.

name: Freeze this moment creates normal frozen session
steps: Run Live Weave with at least two contributing sources
Press Freeze this moment
Inspect the Frozen Weave session receipt
Use Weave frozen session again
expected: The current source state is captured through the existing normal capture path, a replayable fingerprinted session appears, and re-weaving does not silently recapture live state.

name: Three live render modes share one field
steps: Switch to Live Weave
Change render mode from Flow Field to Particle Current to Liquid Mesh
Adjust the same source weight in each mode
expected: All three modes respond to the same rolling weighted signal field rather than maintaining incompatible source state.

name: Fullscreen presentation keeps minimal HUD
steps: Switch to Live Weave
Press Fullscreen
Inspect source count, mode and LIVE / EPHEMERAL label
Hide and show the HUD
expected: The canvas fills the display and the minimal HUD can be hidden without stopping the renderer.

name: Live Weave mobile puts visual first
steps: Open Live Weave on a narrow viewport
Inspect ordering
Scroll below the visual into influence controls
expected: The large visual field appears before the source panel, while live controls remain usable below it.
